seo_description: Sound design and 5.1 surround mix for a 3D jungle animation. Foley, creature vocals, spatial ambience.
hero.title: Akantilado
hero.subtitle: Sound Design / 3D Animation / Foley, 5.1 Surround, Spatial Ambience, Creature Vocals
about.text: Sound design for a 3D jungle animation. Two cats chase a golden orb through the jungle. One falls off a cliff. I did all the foley, ambience, creature vocals, and mixed in 5.1 surround. 200+ custom samples. Worked with composer Noah Bots from Ghent Conservatory. Student project at DAE Howest, 2024.
video.title: Film
approach.title: Approach
approach.jungle_desc: 5 layers: leaves, distant calls, water, wind, room tone. Crossfaded based on camera distance.
approach.characters_desc: Two cats, two vocal palettes. Orange: lower pitch, heavier. Pink: higher pitch, lighter.
approach.foley_desc: Paw steps, climbing, plant rustling. All synced frame by frame to animation.
approach.mix_desc: Stereo for cinema, then 5.1 surround. Jungle split into canopy, ground, and distance zones.
